
## Environment Set Up

The first important thing to take into account to get reproducibility is to have a clean workout is set up the virtual environment.

In python I use conda and for R I will use renv 

here::here for file paths and pathlib for python



# Export the entire environment state to environment.yml
conda env export --no-builds > environment.yml

# If using micromamba:
micromamba env export --no-builds > environment.yml


# To lock a specific environment
micromamba env export --explicit > conda-lock.yml
